overview.description: The Texas Capital Texas Oil Index ETF (OILT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Alerian Texas Weighted Oil and Gas index. The resulting portfolio is a narrow basket of approximately 30 stocks. OILT was launched on Dec 20, 2023 and is issued by Texas Capital.
